install_digit360_package: install the digit360 Python package via pip using setup.py with all required dependencies
configure_digit360_dependencies: configure the digit360 package dependencies including pyserial, betterproto, cobs, and sounddevice
build_digit360_distribution: build a source distribution for the digit360 package using setuptools and find_packages
setup_digit360_metadata: set up package metadata for digit360 including author, description, and GitHub URL
install_digit360_interface: install only the digit360.interface subpackage by configuring find_packages include filter
